newsitem.title: USA: UMB inks Computer Sciences license pact.
newsitem.headline: UMB inks Computer Sciences license pact.

text.p: Computer Sciences Corp said that UMB Financial Corp of Kansas City signed a license and service agreement with its Financial Services Group.

UMB has licensed the Computer Sciences Customer Information System and the Platform Automation Support System, which will provide the infrastructure to build an Enterprise Customer Relationship system across the UMB organization, a news release issued by Computer Sciences said.
The Customer Information System is a comprehensive solution that centralizes customer, account and address data, making it accessible to the entire enterprise, the release said.
The system facilitates relationship marketing by creating a profile of customers that includes products and services, related customers and officer/agent relationships, the release said.
